# API

The methods this package exposes.

## Includes

- `src/*.rb`

## `Store.open`

Open the store.

```ruby
class Store
  def self.open(path)
  end
end
```

## `Store#read`

Read one record.

```ruby
class Store
  def read(key)
  end
end
```

## `Store#write`

Write one record.

```ruby
class Store
  def write(key, value)
  end
end
```
